limitations: One request per backend and length, seed 101, FP32 C4/S1, warm filesystem and compiled-kernel caches, fresh model process.
Migration gate uses existing 1e-3 Angstrom aligned RMSD and 1e-3 numeric summary-confidence delta. It is not an exact-array equality gate.

Historical references contain rounded CIF coordinates and summary confidence only. Raw PAE/PDE arrays are newly retained; exact differences between new native and accelerated arrays are diagnostics, not a newly calibrated acceptance gate.

Native workers were run before the final accelerated routing addition; exact worker/build hashes for each phase are retained. No new kernel optimization or controlled migration-overhead claim is made.

Remaining migration work includes other model variants, accelerated AtlasFold, environment/build provenance, kernel packaging, Rust comparison input parsing and statistics, maintained entrypoint replacement, and OpenFold3 numerical parity.
post_run_test_only_change: The bundle unit test now restores valid pLDDT before testing missing PAE. Production validation behavior is unchanged from the recorded build.
